title: Piyush Goyal leads India's largest business delegation to Japan for trade and investment talks
description: Union Minister Piyush Goyal will visit Japan from August 24 to 27. He leads India's largest business delegation to the country for discussions. Meetings will focus on semiconductors, artificial intelligence, and start-ups. The minister will also promote investment and meet business leaders in Nagoya's auto and steel industries. Osaka will host roadshows showcasing manufacturing and clean energy opportunities.
